scope: Research-only Haumea moon native preparation; no dossier or embedding

native.credit: NASA, ESA, and D. Ragozzine (Brigham Young University); Image Processing: Gladys Kober (NASA/Catholic University of America)
native.instrument: Hubble WFC3 ultraviolet-visible channel, per publisher caption
native.terms: Active NASA image/media guidelines; no verified CC licence asserted. Retain named third-party credits and restrictions.
native.identity: Caption identifies central Haumea and two moons, spelling Hi’iak. Individual upper/lower point crossmatch remains OPEN; no independent association adopted.
native.preservation: Downloaded publisher JPEG unchanged; tiny served download is not claimed to preserve original detector pixels.

limitations: Unresolved/small detections do not establish resolved geography, axes, local chemistry or calibrated visible colour.
Central Haumea, glare, diffraction, background noise and JPEG sampling must not become moon terrain or stars.
Black background does not measure atmospheric absence.
Exact exposure UTC, filters, raw product/coadd, individual point association, publication history and calibrated photometry remain OPEN.
No new angular/raster computation, analogue skin, generated illustration, map, shape or catalogue change.
No exhaustive newest-observation claim; prior Haumea ellipsoid/ring/registration limitations preserved.

validation.preservation: All 550 tracked public files byte-identical to HEAD; 68 dossiers unchanged; queue566. Original/master/native/provenance and recorded Clipper preview retained.
validation.browser: No new passing full artifact or offline browser claim. Other engines remain open.
validation.attribution: Interbuild feed differences unaudited; no savings attribution. Production codecs unchanged.
